: "#N/A" -> "Have you heard? Low dragon roars are echoing from the long-dormant volcano!
Legend has it that the Dragonspire in the center of the mystic realm holds the lingering power of ancient dragons.
Now, that power is awakening. Hearing the news, explorers from three factions have gathered and entered this perilous realm to fight for control of the Dragonfire!
Break through every obstacle and seize the Dragonspire. Who will emerge as the final victor?
The volcano has awakened. The battle has begun!"

: "#N/A" -> "Three teams will each represent a faction and enter a brand-new battlefield map. Obtain supplies by continuously occupying battlefield buildings. After 30 minutes of fierce competition, the faction with the most supplies will claim the final victory."

: "#N/A" -> "Form a team of up to 5 explorers from your server and have the captain start matchmaking. If your team isn't full, the system will automatically fill the remaining spots with other explorers from your server."
: "#N/A" -> "Once matched, three 5-explorer teams will enter the same battlefield, each randomly assigned to one of three factions."
: "#N/A" -> "The battlefield features three types of buildings: Molten Altar, Molten Front, and Dragonspire. Occupying a building will continuously generate battlefield supplies for your faction."

: "#N/A" -> "You can only attack buildings connected to your Camp. If the connection route is severed by the enemy, the disconnected building will stop producing supplies, and you will be unable to dispatch protectors to it."

: "#N/A" -> "The Molten Altar and Molten Front produce 20 supplies per minute, while the Dragonspire produces 50 supplies per minute. Only buildings connected to your Camp can produce supplies normally."
: "#N/A" -> "The first faction to obtain 3000 supplies wins; if no faction reaches 3000 supplies within 30 minutes, the faction with the most supplies wins."

: "#N/A" -> "After entering the battlefield, Armigos in the Camp will be dispatched to the battlefield. Losses incurred from battles in the battlefield will not affect the number of Armigos on the World Map. Severely injured Armigos can be treated in the Event Hospital. Your Camp will enter a ceasefire state."

: "1. Palmon Trials are split into 4 trial towers: Water Tower, Electric Tower, Earth Tower, and Fire Tower.
2. When challenging a trial tower, it is recommended to use Palmon of the corresponding element.
3. Each Palmon and Boss can only participate in 1 trial tower per event phase. Please allocate your Palmon wisely."

: "1. A new event phase begins every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday, resetting the challenge progress.
2. After clearing the current highest chapter for the first time, you may additionally challenge the next new chapter.
3. You may additionally challenge a maximum of 1 new chapter per event phase.
4. During each event phase, you can choose any unlocked chapter to challenge. Cleared chapters can also be challenged repeatedly, but they will not unlock new chapters again."
